# Pelid — Seed Examples (Hand-Written Test Set)
# Domain: Customer Support
# Languages: English, Hindi (Romanized), Malayalam (Romanized)
#
# These are HAND-WRITTEN by the team — never generated by AI.
# They form the held-out TEST SET for measuring accuracy.
# DO NOT use these for training — only for evaluation.
#
# Format: intent_label | example message
# Lines starting with # are comments.
